entries.Modelo Ecocrop (Hijmans et al., 2001; di: Ecocrop model (Hijmans et al., 2001; dismo::ecocrop and Recocrop): each factor is scored 0–1 with a trapezoid between ECOCROP absolute and optimal limits; suitability is the MINIMUM of the factors (law of the minimum); 0 = unsuitable, 1 = optimal. Temperature: trapezoid over the mean of each month of the period, taking the worst month. Frost: Recocrop rule (KTMP−1…KTMP+1 ramp over the monthly extreme minimum). 6-month period = round((GMIN+GMAX)/60) as in dismo; the 12 start months are tried and the best is kept (the factor rasters show that same start). Rainfall: trapezoid over annual rainfall (the FAO data sheet gives the thresholds as «Rainfall (annual)»; with rainfall summed only over the period, as in dismo, almond and wheat suitability was 0 at the 10 climate points because the best thermal period coincides with the dry season). Cycle: that of the FAO data sheet (150–240 days → 6 months) although it is a woody crop, because with 12 months its TMIN of 10 °C gave temperature 0 in winter and suitability 0 in 100% of the cells (convention accepted by the owner); flowering frosts and dormancy outside the chosen period are not assessed. Lethal temperature: «Killing temp. early growth» from the FAO data sheet (−1 °C), the value used by dismo and Recocrop (their KTMP) for the growing period. pH, texture, slope and organic carbon: S1–N classes from the University of Granada suitability tables (based on Sys et al., 1993), scored by class: Score by class (project convention): S1 = 1; S2 = 0.725, S3 = 0.50 and N = 0.20, midpoints of the LUSET class intervals (Yen et al., 2006; Selmy et al., 2024, Agronomy 14(11):2601, table 3, CC BY 4.0). Depth, drainage, carbonates, salinity and varieties are not assessed; the soil is modelled (SoilGrids) and the climate is a mean, not a specific year.

entries.Producto MODELADO (predicción estadístic: MODELLED product (statistical prediction at 250 m from profiles and covariates), not a field measurement: it may not reflect the actual soil of a given parcel and has notable uncertainty at local scale. No data in urban areas, water or bare soil according to the SoilGrids mask.
entries.Producto PROVISIONAL de una sola pareja: PROVISIONAL product from a single pair of dates: it is not a crop or production map. Low coherence may be due to vegetation, tillage, irrigation or rain indistinctly, and also depends on geometry (slope) and radar noise. It is not ground displacement.
entries.Producto PROVISIONAL, no totalmente cali: PROVISIONAL product, not fully calibrated. Radar does not measure production, vigour or moisture on its own: the value mixes roughness, soil moisture, vegetation and viewing geometry (slope and orientation relative to the satellite modify the signal). Compare dates from the same pass, not zones with different passes.
entries.Producto PROVISIONAL. HV es un indicador: PROVISIONAL product. HV is a structure/volume indicator, not production or olive grove health; it is not NDVI. Values near −25…−30 dB may be close to sensor noise. Topography also modifies the signal.
entries.Producto PROVISIONAL: no está totalmente: PROVISIONAL product: not fully calibrated or validated; use relative changes with caution (mission accuracy target: 0.06 m³/m³ in unflagged areas). It only describes the top ~5 cm: it is not equivalent to water available in the root zone or to irrigation needs. Pixels flagged by the product as «not recommended» (bit 0 of retrievalQualityFlag) have been hidden. No estimate in urban or water areas. The overpass time (~05:23 UTC) influences the value.
